example.title: Interaction Example
example.userMessage: I manage 4 aesthetic clinics in HCMC with 15 employees and 10 machines. I want to reduce my electricity bills and attract demanding customers who love quality products and nature. Can you help me?
example.aiMessage: Hello Ms. Hang, yes I can definitely help you with your sustainable growth goals. Let's review your current expenses and equipment inventories. Can you specify if you want to market your actions or just stay discreet? Are you also considering fundraising through green finance in the near future?
